info.description:
Better Metadata - Better Science

The OpenView server hands out CEDAR content that has been marked open, to anyone, without
credentials. It is what makes a published artifact citable: the artifact IRI resolves here for a
reader who has no CEDAR account.

An artifact or folder is served when it is open itself, or when a folder above it is. Anything
else is refused, and nothing here writes.
info.title: CEDAR OpenView Server API

get.description: Return what an open folder holds, with the path back to the workspace root. A folder is served when it is marked open, or when a folder above it is. No credentials are involved: this server exists to hand out open content anonymously.

parameters.description: Comma-separated artifact types to include, in place of all of them.
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.description: Comma-separated sort fields; a leading `-` reverses one.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of entries to skip before the first one returned.
parameters.name: offset

200.description: The folder's contents and its path

400.description: A paging, sort, or filter parameter is not valid

401.description: The folder exists but is not open, and neither is any folder above it

get.summary: List the contents of an open folder

get.description: Return a template element that is open to everyone. An artifact is served when it is marked open, or when it sits under a folder that is. No credentials are involved: this server exists to hand out open artifacts anonymously, which is what makes a published CEDAR artifact citable. Mongo's internal `_id` is removed before the artifact is returned.

parameters.description: Artifact identifier. Either the bare identifier or the full IRI is accepted; a bare one is resolved to the IRI before lookup.
parameters.name: id

401.description: The template element exists but is not open, and neither is any folder above it

503.description: The artifact store could not be reached after the template element was found to be open
